{{Infobox character |games =FOTV |image =FOTV Vault 31 Cryobay.png |race =[[Human]] |gender =Male |family = |location =[[Vault 31]] |role =Junior executive |affiliation =[[Vault 31]]/[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] |TV actor = |dod = |dod verified= }} '''Joseph Moerder''' is a pre-War junior executive of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] who is currently preserved in [[Vault 31]]. ==Background== Moerder was a Vault-Tec junior employee selected to participate in [[Bud Askins]]' executive assistant training program "[[Bud's Buds]]," a plan to create "super managers" who would define the future of humanity after the [[Great War]] wiped out all competitors to Vault-Tec. Moerder and the other Buds would be kept in [[Cryonics|cryostasis]] in Vault 31, periodically thawed out, and transferred to [[Vault 32]] or [[Vault 33|33]] to manage the dwellers and participate in controlled breeding (eugenics), all under Askins' supervision.[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"So what's Vault 32 and 33? Just people to be controlled?"''
[[Bud Askins]]: ''"What? No! When you put it like that, it sounds downright morally questionable. They're our breeding pool, the ultimate expression of HR R&D. Genetically selected to breed with my Buds to create a class of super managers. People with positivity, people who make lemonade. People who will inherit the Earth after we've wiped the surface clean."''

'''Julia Masters''' was a member of the pre-[[Great War|War]] [[REPCONN Aerospace]] [[Pre-War companies|company]], serving as its chief financial officer (CFO). She is [[Fallout: New Vegas characters|mentioned]] {{In|FNV}} and appears {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
===Meeting with Vault-Tec===
At some point prior to the [[Great War]], Julia was invited to attend a meeting at the Southern California [[Vault-Tec headquarters (TV series)|headquarters]] of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] in [[Los Angeles]], along with Vault-Tec's [[Barb Howard]] and [[Bud Askins]], [[Big MT (company)|Big MT]]'s [[Frederick Sinclair]], [[West Tek]]'s [[Leon Von Felden]] and [[RobCo Industries]]'s [[Robert House]].
